Your Trusted Electrical Partner in Canyon Country

Canyon Country, CA residents and businesses need a reliable electrical contractor they can trust. Shaffer Construction, Inc. brings over two decades of experience serving the Santa Clarita Valley with professional electrical services. As a licensed general and electrical contractor, we specialize in everything from EV charger installation to complete electrical system upgrades.

Located in the northern part of Los Angeles County, Canyon Country presents unique electrical needs. Whether you're upgrading an older home in the historic neighborhoods or installing modern electrical systems in new construction, our team understands the specific requirements of Canyon Country properties.

Comprehensive Electrical Services for Canyon Country Homes

Residential electrical work requires expertise, precision, and attention to safety. Our Canyon Country electrician services include panel upgrades, whole-house rewiring, GFCI outlet installation, ceiling fan installation, and lighting upgrades. Many Canyon Country homes were built in the 1970s and 1980s and may need electrical panel upgrades to meet modern power demands.

We understand that today's homes require more electrical capacity than ever before. Smart home devices, home offices, and electric vehicle charging all place greater demands on your electrical system. Our team can assess your current electrical infrastructure and recommend upgrades to ensure safe, reliable power throughout your home.

Electric Vehicle Charger Installation in Canyon Country

As more Canyon Country residents transition to electric vehicles, the need for home EV charging stations continues to grow. Shaffer Construction specializes in residential EV charger installation, helping you add convenient, safe charging right in your garage or driveway. We handle the entire process, from electrical load calculations to permit acquisition and final installation.

Whether you drive a Tesla, Chevrolet Bolt, Nissan Leaf, or any other electric vehicle, we can install the appropriate Level 2 charging station for your needs. Our electricians ensure your home's electrical system can support the additional load and install dedicated circuits to safely power your EV charger. We're familiar with all major EV charging brands including ChargePoint, JuiceBox, and Tesla Wall Connector.

Commercial Electrical Services in Canyon Country

Canyon Country businesses depend on reliable electrical systems to operate efficiently. Shaffer Construction provides comprehensive commercial electrical services including tenant improvements, electrical system upgrades, lighting retrofits, and commercial EV charging station installation. We work with property managers, business owners, and commercial developers throughout the Santa Clarita Valley.

Our commercial electricians understand the importance of minimizing business disruption. We work efficiently to complete projects on schedule and can accommodate after-hours or weekend work when necessary. From small retail spaces to large industrial facilities, we have the expertise to handle commercial electrical projects of any scale.

Electrical Panel Upgrades and Service Enhancements

Many Canyon Country homes still have outdated electrical panels that can't safely handle modern electrical loads. If you're experiencing frequent circuit breaker trips, flickering lights, or planning major renovations or EV charger installation, you may need a panel upgrade. Shaffer Construction specializes in upgrading electrical panels from 100-amp to 200-amp or higher service.

We replace outdated panels from manufacturers like Federal Pacific, Zinsco, and Pushmatic that may pose safety risks. Our licensed electricians ensure all work meets current California electrical code requirements and passes inspection. A modern electrical panel provides the capacity and safety features needed for today's electrical demands.

Why Choose Shaffer Construction for Your Canyon Country Electrical Needs

When you choose Shaffer Construction for your electrical work in Canyon Country, you're partnering with a licensed, insured electrical contractor committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Our electricians are highly trained, background-checked, and stay current with the latest electrical codes and technologies.

We provide transparent pricing, clear communication throughout every project, and stand behind our work with comprehensive warranties. Whether you need emergency electrical repairs, planned upgrades, or new construction electrical installation, our team delivers reliable service you can trust.

Contact Shaffer Construction today for all your Canyon Country electrician needs. Call us at 323-642-8509 or email hello@shaffercon.com to schedule a consultation. We're proud to serve Canyon Country and the entire Santa Clarita Valley with professional electrical services.
